description: Plucked-string voice: a burst of noise fed into six detuned delay lines

params.text: Sets the base frequency of the strings, 20Hz to 400Hz
Sets how long the sound rings on, taking the delay feedback from 0.98 to 1 and the noise burst's release from 200ms to 1 second
Detunes the six delay lines from each other, each one between 0.1% and 1% away from the last

inputs.text: Raises the pitch one octave per volt; the voltage is clamped at 0V and 5V, so it covers five octaves upward and nothing below
A rising edge plucks the string

notes: The number of voices follows the V/OCT jack's channel count, up to four; with nothing patched there the module plays one voice.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage does nothing here.
